notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-007703). Exchange operator: normal operating cash flow, so the formula applies with the sector flag. Total revenues (8,262) are gross of transaction-based expenses paid to market participants; revenues less transaction-based expenses were 5,249. Those rebates and fees are payments to others, so they stay in. Default-fund and margin-deposit flows of the clearing house sit in investing and financing, not operating. Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow (US GAAP), so they are not added. No separate intangible-purchase line; no acquisitions in 2025 (divestiture proceeds of 140 are not netted).
